title:
Italian Chicken
Pastina Soup (aka Italian Nonna's
Penicilin Soup)
ingredients:
Water
Salt
Better than bouillon base
Onion
Cauliflower
Carrots
Celery
Garlic Cloves
Pastina Noodles
Butter
Veggie Broth
Parmesan Cheese
instructions:
- Water w/ salt & better than bouillon base
- Onion
- Cauliflower
- Carrots
- Celery
- Garlic Cloves
- Boil Veggies for 45 Mins/Hour
- Blend Veggies until Creamy and Add Back into Water
- Cook Pastina noodles add butter and veggie broth over
- Serve with Parmesan Cheese
